craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of containment — the Vijñānavāda opponent staged at full strength, then held; śāstra-hammer couplets, negation-anaphora, terminal doctrine words. Both voices in one breath: objection (But how?) + containment (Yet…) — dash is the hinge (argmap: contained within the reply). Rejected: (a) objection/reply split stanzas → killed: containment must happen in one breath. (b) naming Dharmakīrti → killed: imported erudition is vighna (NOTE keeps the mapping in prose, not song). Read aloud: BUT-HOW keep-THEY-one … YET the-THING … STAYS-with-OUT-mark.

lines: But how keep they one, when the existent performs its function,
and the other does not? — Yet the thing, in own self, stays without mark.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kathaṃ syād aviśeṣo 'tra yāvatārthakriyāṃ hi san kuryān nānyas tathāpy artho nirviśeṣo nijātmani

reads_against.argmap: Does function (arthakriyā) distinguish existent from nonexistent? → Function marks the scene, not the self: the objection states itself and is contained within the reply.
c1_essence: Every candidate seat of distinction — predicates, objecthood, conceded difference, free-standing being, function — collapses into knower-dependence; the opponent's no-difference is granted, then outflanked from inside (vv1-8).
Grasping-less awareness is declared inert, and the proof turns: only self-reflective consciousness can stand as ground (v9).
